3d-force-graph browser bundle
================================

Graphify includes the minified UMD browser bundle from 3d-force-graph 1.80.0:

  https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph/tree/1.80.0
  dist/3d-force-graph.min.js
  SHA-384: 63b6c2d8f04abbcba3c6dbe8e7e67ad4e786752551cc5b185812b88b97672ff53a6850d3a1d93ad6a3949137c89dac52

3d-force-graph is Copyright (c) 2017 Vasco Asturiano and is distributed under
the MIT License. Its license text is included in 3d-force-graph.LICENSE.txt.

The UMD build contains the following runtime packages. Versions were resolved
from the upstream 1.80.0 yarn.lock used to build the reviewed distribution.
Their license notices and source are available from the linked upstream
projects.
